what_happened.line: The committee outlined three possible town meeting warrant articles for the TCP site, and left them unresolved, with the third's procedure to be raised with the town manager or Select Board chair.
The chair will call the town manager or Select Board chair about how the third article should proceed procedurally.
The committee worked through inputs for the architect's study of a possible new building: floors, noise, security and parking.
The committee approved the June 16 minutes by vote and adjourned.
Next meetings were set for September 8 and September 22, same time, on Zoom.

why_it_matters: Any article that reaches the warrant is a vote residents may be asked to take at town meeting, and a renovation funding article would ask the town to appropriate or borrow, which is paid mostly through taxes.

A member noted that a third article would bring cumulative design spending near the half-million figure of the middle/high school project, so the design studies themselves are a cost to the town budget.
